text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan (Pindaan Jadual) 2012.

 (2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada

1 Ogos 2012.

Pindaan Jadual

2. Jadual kepada Akta dipinda―

(a) di bawah tajuk "SALARIES AND FIXED ALLOWANCES"—

(i) berkenaan dengan tajuk "PUBLIC SERVICES COMMISSION", dengan

menggantikan subperenggan 1, 2 dan 3 dengan subperenggan

yang berikut:

Per month

"1. Chairman:

Salary RM14,607.70

2. Deputy Chairman:

Salary RM12,201.84

3. Members:

Fixed allowance RM11,264.26";

(ii) berkenaan dengan tajuk "JUDICIAL AND LEGAL SERVICE

COMMISSION", dengan menggantikan angka "6,379.64" dengan

angka "11,264.26";

(iii) berkenaan dengan tajuk "POLICE SERVICE COMMISSION", dengan

menggantikan angka "6,379.64" dengan angka "11,264.26"; dan

(iv) berkenaan dengan tajuk "EDUCATION SERVICE COMMISSION",

dengan menggantikan subperenggan 1, 2 dan 3 dengan

subperenggan yang berikut:

 Per month

"1. Chairman:

Salary RM14,607.70

2. Deputy Chairman:

Salary RM12,201.84

3. Members:

Fixed allowance RM11,264.26";

(b) di bawah tajuk "ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES APPLICABLE TO ALL

COMMISSIONS"—

(i) dengan menggantikan perenggan 8 dengan perenggan yang

berikut:

"8. ADVANCE TO PURCHASE MOTOR VEHICLES:

(payable within the term of office of the member during

which the advance is given on such terms and conditions

as stipulated in the Treasury Circular or Circular Letter

for Advance to Purchase Motor Vehicles for members of

the public services or as may be determined by the

Treasury from time to time)

Chairmen and Deputy Chairmen of

all Service Commissions

RM70,000

Members of all Service

Commissions

RM65,000";

(ii) dengan menggantikan perenggan 9 dengan perenggan yang

berikut:

 "9. MEETING ALLOWANCE:

(a) The Chairman of Public Services Commission shall

receive an allowance of RM500 per day or part

thereof for attending a meeting or meetings of

Judicial and Legal Service Commission or any

Committee or Board thereof.

(b) (applicable only to ex-officio members and members

appointed from among serving judges and other

Commissions)

There shall be paid an allowance of RM300 per day

or part thereof for attending a meeting or meeting of

a Commission or any Committee or Board thereof or

as may be determined by the Government from time

to time."; dan

(iii) dengan memasukkan selepas perenggan 23 perenggan yang

berikut:

"24. SICK LEAVE:

A member of a Commission is entitled to sick leave

subject to the terms and conditions stipulated in Part lll

Chapter C General Orders 1974 and the Services Circular

No. 2 of 2006 or any amendments thereto.".

Dibuat 14 Ogos 2012

[PM(BK)R. 11334/1 Jld. 21; PN(PU2)372/II]

Dengan Titah Perintah

DATO' SRI DR. ALI BIN HAMSA

Setiausaha Jemaah Menteri
